title: S&P Select Sector Indices December rebalance — the Quarterly Qualification Date close that prices the capping trade printed into the 2027-12-17 witching
source: EST: date derived by applying an SEC-filed rule to the 2027 calendar, with the rule RE-FETCHED AND RE-READ IN FULL by this session rather than inherited from the proposal or from any sibling ledger. SEC EDGAR, Select Sector SPDR Trust Form 497 (accession 0001193125-26-031948, d85739d497.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 2,388,335 bytes — byte-identical to four prior sibling fetches), verbatim: 'If on the second Friday of any calendar quarter-end month (a "Quarterly Qualification Date"), a Component Stock (or two or more Component Stocks) approaches the maximum allowable value limits set forth above (the "Asset Diversification Limits"), the percentage that such Component Stock (or Component Stocks) represents in the Select Sector Index will be reduced…' and 'The rebalancing of the Select Sector Indices, based on the processes described above, occurs at the closing prices of the second Friday of March, June, September and December. Changes will become effective after the market close on the third Friday of March, June, September and December.' December 2027's Fridays are the 3rd, 10th, 17th, 24th and 31st (weekday arithmetic recomputed mechanically this session), so the Quarterly Qualification Date is 2027-12-10 and capping goes effective after the 2027-12-17 close — a third Friday independently corroborated on OCC's own 2027 calendar by opex-2027-12-17. Filed estimate rather than SEC:/confirmed on three counts, one of them new: the filing dates the RULE, not this instance, and no 2027-dated S&P DJI or SPDR schedule has been fetched; this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep; and THE OPERATIVE FILING IS UNDER LIVE AMENDMENT — 485APOS Post-Effective Amendment No. 60 (accession 0001193125-26-303372, filed 2026-07-14, fetched direct 2026-09-09) carries a complete Statement of Additional Information in which the entire capping methodology is ABSENT (zero occurrences of 'second Friday', 'Quarterly Qualification', 'Asset Diversification', 'Component Stock', '4.8%' or 'CONSTRUCTION AND MAINTENANCE', against 2/2/6/29/several/1 in the January 497), and whose own table-of-contents preamble drops the words 'the Select Sector Indices' from the sentence naming what was sourced externally. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-12-10 initial research (2026-09-09) after reading the single proposal for this id in full — proposals/sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-12-10.from-sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-12-20.json, which is now inert and shadowed. The proposal's framing is carried forward and one figure of its own is added. WHAT THE PROPOSAL GOT RIGHT AND THIS SESSION RE-VERIFIED: this is the pricing date for the concentrated single-name component of the 2027-12-17 witching close (~$1.10B one-way against $391B of Select Sector SPDR assets, a size measured by the March sibling on issuer holdings files and NOT re-measured here — 2026 weights say nothing about December 2027); the December witching close is a QUARTERLY-sized execution hazard, not a December-sized one (SPY third-Friday relative volume 1.639x mean / 1.789x median in December vs 1.420x / 1.377x for Mar/Jun/Sep, Mann-Whitney p=13.6%, n=21 — only the step over an ordinary monthly opex Friday is established, p=1.89%); and no house playbook is rebalance-, opex- or index-flow-keyed (re-grepped 2026-09-09, zero hits). WHAT THIS SESSION ADDS. (1) THE SOURCING RISK ABOVE, which no sibling caught: the pending 485APOS removes the rule text this entry and four sibling entries derive their dates from, and S&P DJI's own methodology PDFs 403 this runner, so the calendar could lose its only fetchable primary for the second-Friday rule around 2026-09-27 (75 days after filing under Rule 485(a)(2)). The rule itself is S&P DJI's, not SSGA's, so the MECHANISM is very unlikely to change; what changes is what this lane can cite. Registered as FT-sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-12-10-1. (2) THE REFERENCE-TO-EFFECTIVE WEDGE, SIZED FOR THE FIRST TIME. The cap arithmetic is struck on this close's prices but the trade prints five sessions later, so the executed trade differs from the priced one by the capped name's relative drift. Measured across ten mega-cap/sector-ETF pairs over 944 quarterly windows 1999-2026: mean |wedge| 2.37%, median 1.47%, p90 5.23%. On a 24.36%-to-23.00% single-name cap that moves the trade by 20% of its priced size at the median, 32% at the mean and 71% at p90, and a -7.4% wedge (5.1% of windows) erases the trim entirely. IT IS NOT AN ANOMALY AND MUST NOT BE READ AS ONE: December is indistinguishable from the other quarterly legs (MW p=61.0%, n=232 vs 712), signed drift is a coin flip (118/232 positive), and a placebo over all 59,765 overlapping five-session windows on the same pairs is if anything slightly WIDER (mean 2.49%, median 1.53%, p90 5.58%). The wedge is one ordinary week of single-name-vs-sector dispersion — which is exactly the useful statement, because it puts a number on how much a reference close does not determine. (3) THE CORRIDOR SHAPE IS THE OPPOSITE OF MARCH'S. The March sibling recorded that 2027-03-12 carries no macro print at all, so the caps price on an ordinary tape. Here fomc-2027-12-08 (high, estimate, the year's final SEP meeting) sits two sessions before this close, and ndx-annual-reconstitution-announcement-2027-12-10 lands after the close on this very session — after the prices are struck, so it cannot contaminate the cap arithmetic, but it can move the 12-13 to 12-17 drift of any name it touches. The house instrument scripts/research/fomc-expiration-proximity.mjs exists precisely to stop a lane reinstating an FOMC-proximity corridor rule on a gap-+2 shape; re-run fresh this session, the raw +2 result (2.147 vs 1.862 relvol, P=0.002) dies era-ranked (P=0.326) and REVERSES in the modern era (-0.080, P=0.535). This lane therefore declines to build one. Low impact and market-structure only: it changes execution timing, never direction. Filed estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
